children: Diamond Estates issued 32,465,316 shares to convert $4.7M of debenture principal and $1.5M of accrued interest. The Lassonde Group's ownership rose from approximately 50.85% to 66.19%; it no longer holds debentures.
Lassonde Group stake rose to 66.19% from 50.85%
The group's majority position increased substantially, concentrating ownership and voting influence.
The large share issuance dilutes existing holders; no prior-period comparison was provided.
Converts the debenture obligations into equity, but the release gives no post-conversion balance-sheet figures.
The company said repayment was not permitted under certain Bank of Montreal credit-facility covenants.

This is a concrete ownership and capital-structure change, following the terms of the debentures and the company's earlier November 6 disclosure. Further share issuances, ownership changes, or disclosure of the resulting debt and share-count position would clarify the continuing impact.
